en.headline: Dedicated public transport lanes open for new Huanggang Port
en.dek: The Transport Department has set up lanes on Fanling Highway and San Tin Highway so franchised buses, cross-boundary coaches and minibuses can reach San Sham Road without using the busy San Tin Interchange.
body: The Transport Department said on Monday that dedicated public-transport lanes have been established on Fanling Highway and San Tin Highway leading to a road that connects to the redeveloped Huanggang Port.

According to the department, the lanes allow franchised buses, cross-boundary coaches and green minibuses to travel directly via San Sham Road and avoid the busier San Tin Interchange. The arrangement is intended to improve service reliability, speed up vehicle turnover and help disperse passengers more efficiently once the port opens.

The department reminded motorists that the lanes, located on the northbound slip roads from San Tin Highway and Fanling Highway toward the cross-boundary freight bridge, are reserved exclusively for the designated public-transport vehicles. Drivers were advised to follow roadside signs and road markings and to select the correct lane in good time.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸公共運輸專用車道啟用 免經新田交匯處
zh.dek: 運輸署已在粉嶺公路及新田公路增設專用車道，讓專營巴士、跨境巴士及專線小巴直達新深路前往新口岸，無需駛經較繁忙的新田交匯處。
body: 運輸署周一表示，已增設由粉嶺公路及新田公路直達新深路的公共運輸專用車道，配合新皇崗口岸即將啟用。
署方指，專營巴士、跨境巴士及專線小巴可經新深路直接前往新口岸，無需駛經較繁忙的新田交匯處，有助提升班次準時性、加快車輛流轉及疏散乘客。
專用車道設於新田公路及粉嶺公路往新深路（過境貨車橋）北行支路，只供指定公共運輸車輛使用。運輸署提醒駕駛人士留意沿途交通標誌及道路標記，及早選定合適行車線。
